scene.speaker: tomas
scene.bubble: The sun says good morning, the moon says good night… and Pip sleeps at both times!
scene.intro: The sun says good morning and the moon says good night. In the morning Tomás wakes up, eats his breakfast and runs to school. In the afternoon he plays outside. In the evening he reads a book, and at night he sleeps — well, almost. Pip sleeps all day and wakes up at night, because puffins have their own clock! What do you do in the morning? Tell us your day!

data.script: Freya: Tell me your day, Tomás! … Tomas: In the morning I wake up at seven and eat bread with jam. … Tomas: At midday, lunch at school. Rice day! … Tomas: In the afternoon, football at the park. … Tomas: In the evening I have dinner and a warm shower. … Freya: And at night? … Tomas: I look at the stars from my window… and sleep at nine. … Freya: Sweet dreams, Tomás!
